question: A, B and C invest a sum in the ratio of 63 : 35 : 42, respectively. If they earned a total profit of ₹5,120 at the end of the year, then what is the difference between share of B and C?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Simplified investment ratio of A : B : C = 63 : 35 : 42 = 9 : 5 : 6

Total profit ratio parts = 9 + 5 + 6 = 20 parts

20 parts = ₹5,120 ⇒ 1 part = 5120 ÷ 20 = ₹256

Difference between the profit share of C and B = 6 parts − 5 parts = 1 part

**∴ The correct answer is ₹256.**
